caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher rendered in grayscale pencil on a beige background. The pitcher has a rounded, bulbous body with a narrow neck that flares out into a wide, undulating lip. The lip features multiple soft curves, creating a decorative, scalloped edge. The handle is large, elaborate, and curves outward with gentle bends before joining the upper part of the pitcher. The body of the pitcher is supported by three short, curved legs, each terminating in a rounded foot. There is a subtle shading effect used throughout the body and handle, accentuating the three-dimensional form of the pitcher. The beige background is plain, with a small, irregularly shaped brown spot to the left of the pitcher. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Silver Cream Pitcher
